name: Drifty · Gremlet #48
description:
A little jellyfish spirit that drifts through the air as if it were still in the sea.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Drifty in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
